requirements_summary: RAG across multiple sources: ticketing DB (Zendesk), product docs (Confluence), internal wiki, S3 attachments
Citations with provenance on every agent-facing suggestion; link back to original ticket or doc and timestamp
Freshness SLAs: critical KB items must be re-ingested or incremental-updated within 24-72h; support for delta ingestion and hooks
Lat/throughput targets: support ~1k concurrent agents with bursts to 4k QPS; p95 retrieval latency <= 250ms, p99 generation <= 800ms
Reliability under spikes: predictable throttling/fallback (cached answers, lower-cost model) and graceful degradation policies
Tool-calling: secure function/tool calls for ticket create/update with audit trail and role-based permissions
Privacy/residency: some EU customers require data never leave eu-central region and KMS control
notes:
Summary of conversations and on-record asks:
- Priya (Head of Ops): 'Agents must see a citation and time for any suggested reply — we need traceability for audits.'
- Want hybrid ingestion: nightly full sync + streaming deltas from ticketing system.
- Sample dataset delivered: 215k segments (Zendesk tickets + Confluence + 12k attachments). SE requested vector store benchmarks and cold-start latency.
- Concern: previous vendor had unreliable retrieval during peak promo windows -> 'we cannot let agents wait'. Looking for autoscaling + fallback policies.
- Commercial: flexible mix of base Dedicated units + overage pricing preferred; exploring 12-18 month commitment.
- Compliance: need SOC2 + ability to enable customer-managed KMS; encryption-in-transit and at-rest mandatory.
- POC success metrics: F1 of retrieval vs gold citations >= 0.78, average citation precision > 0.9 for top-3, and end-to-end agent turn-time reduction >= 30%.
